ar.title: رستو البط

steps.n1: يدعك البصل المفري بالملح والفلفل والبهار والزعتر.
steps.n2: تضاف الملعقة الكبيرة من السمن والبقسماط ويخلطوا جيدا، ثم تعجن باللبن حتى تصير لينة.
steps.n3: تحشى البطة بهذه الخلطة وتوضع في صينية مدهونة بالزيت أو السمن، ويرش على الوجه مقدار من السمن أو الزيت وتغطى بالفويل.
steps.n4: تدخل في فرن متوسط الحرارة حتى النضج، ثم يرفع الفويل حتى يحمر الوجه.

en.title: Roasted Duck

steps.n1: Rub the sliced onions with salt, pepper, mixed spices, and thyme.
steps.n2: Add the tablespoon of ghee and the breadcrumbs, mixing well, then knead with milk until the mixture becomes soft.
steps.n3: Stuff the duck with this mixture and place it in a baking tray greased with oil or ghee; drizzle some ghee or oil over the top and cover with foil.
steps.n4: Place in a medium-heat oven until cooked through, then remove the foil to allow the skin to brown.

legacySteps: Rub the sliced onions with salt, pepper, mixed spices, and thyme.
Add the tablespoon of ghee and the breadcrumbs, mixing well, then knead with milk until the mixture becomes soft.
Stuff the duck with this mixture and place it in a baking tray greased with oil or ghee; drizzle some ghee or oil over the top and cover with foil.
Place in a medium-heat oven until cooked through, then remove the foil to allow the skin to brown.
